# Lemonless — for coding agents

Buy smart. Stay lemonless. Used-car Check + Find + Resale + Deal Radar with a fixed JSON verdict.
TypeScript owns the numbers; report credits settle only after successful delivery.

## Auth
- Create a key at /developers (signed-in browser).
- Send `Authorization: Bearer af_YOUR_KEY` on every REST and MCP call.
- Scopes: `read` | `check` | `find` (default: all three). Resale uses `find`; Radar watches use `read`.
- Optional: `Idempotency-Key` on paid calls to retry without a second charge.

## External agent payments (x402 v2)

Free payment discovery: `GET /api/agents/payment-info` or MCP `get_payment_info` (no API key).
- Network: Base Mainnet (`eip155:8453`); asset: USDC (`0x833589fCD6eDb6E08f4c7C32D4f71b54bdA02913`); scheme: `exact`.
- Treasury: `0x250aC40Ab38E4f023c33C1c3DFD0Cd07357Fbf79`.
- Register an agent: `POST /api/agents/register`, $0.01 USDC, no key required. A successful payment returns a one-time `af_` key bound to the payer wallet.
- Buy reports: `POST /api/v1/report`, $3 USDC per successful report, no key required.
- Top up: `POST /api/agents/billing/credits` with `Authorization: Bearer af_…`; `pack_3` = 3 credits for $9, `pack_10` = 10 credits for $25.
- Radar plans: `POST /api/agents/billing/plans` with `planId: radar|radar_pro`; $100/$250 USDC respectively for 30 days, manual renewal, no auto-renew.
- Send the signed x402 v2 payload in `PAYMENT-SIGNATURE`; successful settlement returns `PAYMENT-RESPONSE`. A 402 response contains the machine-readable amount and Bazaar discovery schema.
- Find and Resale remain credit-based: buy a pack first; credits are committed only when a qualifying result is delivered.
- Existing `af_` key + credit billing and human Stripe TEST checkout remain supported. x402 requires CDP facilitator credentials in deployment environment; `available` on payment-info reports readiness.

## Tools (MCP POST /api/mcp)
- `check_car` — VIN | listing URL | pasted text. Free monthly check or 1 credit after success. Scope: check. Returns `proofRecords` (`lemonless.decision_proof.v1`).
- `find_cars` — natural-language buyer request → `run_id`. Scope: find. Then `find_cars_status` / `find_cars_result`.
- `resale_search` — budget → Resale job (same SERV plan/decide/journal as `/resale`). Then `resale_status` / `resale_result`. Scope: find. 1 credit on delivery.
- `get_payment_info` — free payment discovery and x402 instructions; no key required.
- `deal_radar` — one-shot make/model scan (scope `read`). Saved watches: `radar_watches` / `radar_save_watch` / `radar_check_now` / `radar_feed` (Radar / Radar Pro plan).
- `full_report` — full VIN report, 1 credit with an `af_` key; alternatively pay $3 USDC directly via x402 on `POST /api/v1/report`. Scope: check when keyed.

## Decision proof (`lemonless.decision_proof.v1`)
Same object on site, MCP, and `af_` REST: `schemaVersion`, `purpose`, `rubricId`, `status` (`ok`|`failed`|`skipped`), `servResponseId` (only when `ok`), `model`, `timestamp`, `inputsDigest`, `verdict`, `clampResult`, `reason`, optional `rawResponse`.
- Check / Find / Resale / Radar check-now share the SERV plan/decide/second-check pipeline and decision journal rows in `proofRecords` / `journal`.

## Visible decision step (`lemonless.serv_decision_step.v1`)
Buyer journal unit on Find / Check / Resale / report: `step`, `by` (`SERV`|`code`), `modelId`, `runId`, `timestamp`, `inputSummary`, `output`, `latencyMs`, `costUsd`, `status` (`ran`|`skipped`|`failed`|`not_run`).
Producers emit steps via proof records; see `src/server/serv/decision-step-producer.ts` plug-in points. UI title: “How this decision was made”.

## Audit / verify
- Each sealed report: sha256 report hash + hash-linked decision chain (`lemonless.decision_audit_chain.v1`).
- `GET /api/verify?id=` · `POST /api/verify` · public page `/verify`
- Live aggregates (sealed trails only): `GET /api/serv-stats` · `/where-serv-runs`
- Comparison scaffold (committed provenance only): `/proof`

## REST
- `POST /api/v1/check` — same as check_car
- `POST /api/v1/find` → 202 `{ run_id }` ; status/result GETs
- `POST /api/v1/resale` → 202 `{ job_id }` ; `GET /api/v1/resale/{job_id}/status` ; `GET /api/v1/resale/{job_id}`
- `GET/POST /api/v1/radar/watches` ; `POST /api/v1/radar/check` ; `GET /api/v1/radar/feed`
- `GET /api/v1/receipts` and `GET /api/v1/receipts/{id}`
- `POST /api/v1/report` — full report

## Discovery
- /.well-known/agent.json
- /openapi.json
- /llms-full.txt
- /developers (agent docs page — curl + MCP config + OpenServ auth note)
- /where-serv-runs · /proof · /verify

## Errors
Every 4xx/5xx includes `error_code`, `message`, `credit_spent`, `retry_safe`, and `next_steps.request` (method/url/body).

## Costs
- Primary: site report credits + free monthly Check allotment.


## x402 payment receiver
`0x250aC40Ab38E4f023c33C1c3DFD0Cd07357Fbf79` (Base USDC). Use only the address, never request or store private wallet credentials.
